\section{Results}
Figure~\ref{fig:trend} illustrates a small increasing trend. Table~\ref{tab:values} lists the corresponding observations. Together they provide a compact example of graphical and tabular content in an Elsevier manuscript.

\begin{figure}[ht]
\centering
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=1.2cm,y=0.8cm]
  \draw[->] (0,0) -- (3.5,0) node[right] {Step};
  \draw[->] (0,0) -- (0,3.3) node[above] {Value};
  \draw[thick] (0.5,0.8) -- (1.5,1.6) -- (2.5,2.5);
  \foreach \x/\y in {0.5/0.8,1.5/1.6,2.5/2.5}
    \fill (\x,\y) circle (2pt);
\end{tikzpicture}
\caption{An increasing trend across three steps.}
\label{fig:trend}
\end{figure}

\begin{table}[ht]
\centering
\caption{Values at each step.}
\label{tab:values}
\begin{tabular}{lr}
\toprule
Step & Value \\
\midrule
1 & 0.8 \\
2 & 1.6 \\
3 & 2.5 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}
